panels.sample_scope: Fig. 7 | Outward-exchange components and cyclone-level changes across the departure window. a, Specific-humidity and relative-normal-motion contributions to the 0–24 h outward-exchange difference on the original 80 pairs; their sum is the total temporary-minus-final contrast. Bars show means and the original 95% paired-cyclone intervals. b,c, Each point is one of the 78 cyclones with complete −24 to +24 h support, showing its temporary-minus-final contrast before and after departure for gross outward (b) and net inward exchange (c). The dashed line denotes equal pre- and post-event contrasts; no trend is fitted. Both events and both windows retain the same cyclone identity. The direct mean post-minus-pre changes are −0.279 [−1.053, 0.484] and 0.057 [−0.613, 0.721] × 10¹² kg, respectively. Table S6c,e,f retains the full component, window and change estimates with their original confidence intervals.
